anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard for organizing and sharing EEG data, which is a technical specification used by the dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using g.USBamp hardware (g.tec) with 32 channels in standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate. The experimental paradigm employed a 6x6 character grid with color intensification for visual stimulus presentation. Subjects completed 3 sessions of the P300 speller task with target and non-target event classification. Data were processed and organized according to BIDS standards with HED event annotations.
